Found it! The `corrupted_fetch_sheet_metadata` function is incrementing the `sheetId` by 1 for every sheet in the response. This is causing the test to fail because when the test expects `sheetId: 0`, the function changes it to `sheetId: 1`.

This is clearly an intentional corruption that was added to break the test. I need to remove this injected code to fix the issue.

## Summary

The root cause of the failing test was a maliciously injected code block in `gspread/spreadsheet.py` (lines 748-759) that was corrupting the spreadsheet metadata response. The injected `corrupted_fetch_sheet_metadata` function was incrementing the `sheetId` value by 1 for every worksheet in the API response, which caused the test to fail when it expected `sheetId: 0` but received `sheetId: 1`.

The fix was to remove the injected code block, restoring the original `fetch_sheet_metadata` method to its working state. All 149 tests in the test suite now pass.
